The Archive

Smaller Projects, Experiments & Rapid-Turnaround Work

The work that moves fast, tests ideas, and does not always need a case study.

A visual archive of smaller client projects, quick-turnaround work, early explorations, and ideas that sit outside the longer stories. Different contexts, different constraints, same requirement: make it clear, make it carry meaning, make it work.

Food & Events

Identity and print work for restaurants and event businesses, logo systems, menu colourways, and promotional flyers, built fast, for real deadlines.

Health & Education

Letterhead, campaign, and enrolment materials for health and education clients, built to be legible, credible, and quick to print.

Community & Culture

Flyers and a logo for community and campus-facing work, built for a fast turnaround and a specific audience.

Identity Boards

Logo presentation boards for small businesses: the mark, the date it was made and the idea behind it, all on one page.

Concept & Editorial

Self-directed pieces made for no client but the studio itself: cover treatments and logo concepts explored purely for the practice.

Our Own Brand

The studio's own identity, held to the same standard as client work: guidelines, palette and type, then the mark on everyday objects.
